needs_human.note: If /subscriptions/resolve fails, the Composer sends a channel URL to createLoft, both after a failed preview (cached as unknown at Composer.tsx:153) and at submit (Composer.tsx:181). The tests encode this behavior. The resolve route does pure parsing (router.py:291-301), so in normal use the failure mostly coincides with /link failing too, and I did not raise it as a finding.; A preview that answers after a successful submit still runs setKind and writes classified.current (Composer.tsx:143-144), so the empty composer can show Subscribe and the display-mode field until the next URL. The same stale setKind existed before this change. It affects display only, because submit now decides from its own classification.; classified.current is keyed by URL only, not by drive. The resolve route's classification does not depend on the drive, so a drive change without remount does not produce a wrong kind today.; A folder filled in by an earlier URL's preview stays selected for the next URL, and rememberFolder then writes it under the new kind (Composer.tsx:174, 205). decisions.md observed this. The folder-retaining condition is unchanged from the old code and the folder is visible in the picker.
